summary: Iter14 UDAMG multi-role users admin — backend 23/23 pytest passing (RBAC, admin/users CRUD, ville restrictions, membre gate, own-contacts scope, register disabled, Google session gate). Frontend flows validated on mobile viewport 390x844: pasteur sees menu-team-card + 3 pôles, membre sees ONLY Pôle 3 (no team-card, no Pôle 1/2), ouvrier sees 3 pôles without team-card. /users admin CRUD works end-to-end (create testfront membre → appears in list, deletion via API). All 4 seeded accounts login and expose ville_id/ville_nom/is_approved. Google /auth/session gate returns 401 for invalid session_id, source review confirms 403 email_not_approved for unknown emails. Registration disabled returns 403 with detail.code='registration_disabled'.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' (RN 0.79+). Non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: e.g. /app/frontend/app/(app)/users.tsx (userCard shadow via colors.card shadow), /app/frontend/app/(app)/menu.tsx card style
Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking, coming from a component (likely LinearGradient/absoluteFillObject overlay). Should be migrated.

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow (RN 0.79) and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence deprecation warnings. Non-blocking.
No functional fixes required — iteration 14 complete.

google_session endpoint properly rejects unknown emails (403 email_not_approved) and disabled/non-approved existing users.
